title: Camarones a la Peruvienne
description: A French-inspired Peruvian-style shrimp recipe with a smoky twist. This easy-to-make dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: De Camarones Fish Stock
ingredients.notes: chicken or seafood stock as substitute

ingredients.name: Chupe de Mar (Peruvian Seafood Stew Mix)

instructions: Heat the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced Aji Amarillo Chili and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Add the white wine and fish stock, and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the Chupe de Mar (or seafood seasoning) and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the shrimp hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
